The institutional investor held 4.04 million shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $337.89 million, down from 4.07 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Salient Trust Company Lta who had been investing in Exxon Mobil Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $330.11 billion market cap company.
